description: Figure 10 is a bar chart illustrating the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, and the horizontal axis lists different language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The bars are color-coded to represent different models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. Each bar's height indicates the effect size, with error bars showing the standard deviation. The chart shows that the effect of context masking varies across language families, with some families showing a significant perturbation, particularly for case tasks and adjectives. The error bars indicate the variability of the effect sizes within each group.
